### 12. Contract

**Build-readiness notes (D-RCV-60, 26 November 2026).**

- Deviation route rules (GAP-1826): this slice carries R-DEV-01, R-DEV-02, R-DEV-03, R-DEV-05, R-DEV-06, R-DEV-07, R-DEV-08, R-DEV-09, R-DEV-12, R-DEV-15, R-DEV-17 and R-DEV-18 as named in the feature tables, and adds R-DEV-19 (re-route), R-DEV-20 (escalation after 10 working days) and R-DEV-21 (unmapped code to the team manager) from the design. R-DEV-04, R-DEV-10, R-DEV-11, R-DEV-13, R-DEV-14, R-DEV-16 and R-DEV-22 are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1826). Package authoring, its version label and promotion to the rule registry stay in rwb-decision.
- Entity groups (GAP-1819): the deviation store holds a screening run with its mode, a screening score row per code with precision, recall and sample size, a contact stop kept until lifted, an agent feedback row, and a breach record for a contact sent against a stop. Physical names stay as the Ownership Map holds them (rwb_deviation); the data architect adds the missing map rows.
- Events (GAP-1832): DeviationRaised (EV-06) and DeviationCleared (EV-07) on rwb.deviation.events.v1 are keyed by case and carry the code, state, contact stop flag, return point and decision record reference in the envelope. No personal or financial value travels. The schema is written with the contract story.
- Open values (GAP-0411, GAP-0625, GAP-0626): the SIT harness environment, SCREEN-S2 fixture pack, test profile, evidence format and wave 2 gate are agreed at the wave 2 entry check and held as data files with the story. Until then they read as Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0411). The rwb-agent login, the S8 raise path and refusal codes, the parameter keys of the 0.80 confidence floor, the segment values and the promotion condition, the sealed decision-entry read, and the gateway-bff route are fixed at the owner milestones named in those items. Until then the story uses placeholders and builds no code value (GAP-2193, GAP-2194).
- Raise request (GAP-3100): the REST request carries caseId, deviationCode, reason, documentIds, raisedBy and agentRunId, plus the return point, the agent version and the policy segment pair. The field names of those three are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-3100). The agent-policy read operation, the partial unique index of one open code per case and the envelope type of the decision-record entry are set in the contract and DB stories. The test level of each legacy case is set in the Test Cases workbook.
- Decision-log write (GAP-2402): the append is assumed as POST /api/recovery/decision/v1/decision-log with the request and DecisionRecord answer of section 12.1, until the wave 2 contract review confirms it with rwb-decision.
